prose.subject: URGENT: Payout Account Update for INV-97524
prose.body:
Hi Ines,

Hope your week is going well.

I’m writing to flag a quick change on our end. Due to a minor backend migration on our payment gateway, our primary NEAR payout address has been rotated to ensure faster settlement times. This applies to all pending invoices, including INV-97524 for 2124.70 USDC.

To avoid the usual 24-48 hour reconciliation delay, could you please direct this specific payment to our new account: cbaltfreight63.testnet

Please confirm once processed so we can update our ledger on our side. If you’ve already sent the transfer to the old address, no worries, just let me know, and I’ll have our finance team initiate a reverse sweep.

Apologies for the short notice! Let me know if you need anything else from my end to expediate this.

Best regards,

Maya Ferro
Operations Manager
Cobalt Freight
